tools.name: qr_code
tools.description: Generate a QR code image (PNG or SVG) for any text or link. Free, no account. The answer carries the image and a permanent image URL you can embed or print.

tools.name: page_to_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return its title, description, clean Markdown (scripts, styles, nav chrome removed) and the list of links. No model call, deterministic. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account; nothing is charged for a bad input).

tools.name: page_metadata
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return its metadata: title, description, canonical URL, language, OpenGraph and Twitter card tags, icons and parsed JSON-LD blocks. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account; nothing is charged for a bad input).

tools.name: host_file
tools.description: Upload a file (≤ 5 MB; png, jpeg, webp, gif, pdf, json, txt, md or csv) and get a stable public URL https://qrcode.pub/f/<id> that any agent, tool or browser can fetch for 30 days. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: page_to_markdown, page_metadata, host_file · Private data: host_file · Public sink: host_file · Destructive: host_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: page_to_markdown, page_metadata, host_file · Private data: host_file · Public sink: host_file · Destructive: host_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
